newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHELL CUTS GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHELL CUTS GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Nederland BV said on Tuesday it would cut its retail prices for gasoline in the Netherlands by one guilder-cent per litre and for diesel by two guilder-cents per litre with effect from Thursday, February 13.
The move reflects changes in international product prices and the value of the dollar against the guilder, it said.
From Thursday the price of premium unleaded gasoline at Shell's self-service stations will fall to 2.11 guilders per litre.
The price of premium with lead substitute will fall to 2.189 guilders and that of Euro regular unleaded to 2.06 guilders.
The recommended price for diesel will go down to 1.488 guilders per litre, Shell said.
